originalTitle: Airbnb shares surge 15% to four-year high on raised forecast, AI gains
simplifiedContent: Airbnb's stock price jumped up by 15% to its highest point in four years. This happened because the company said it expects to make more money this year than it previously thought, due to people still wanting to travel and the company using artificial intelligence to work more efficiently. The company also made more money than expected in the last quarter and spent less on customer support, which made investors happy. This is important because it shows that investors are confident in Airbnb's ability to do well, even with some uncertainty in the world, like tensions in the Middle East. As a result, more people are buying Airbnb's stock, which is driving up its price.

originalTitle: Doximity shares soar 60% after CEO says its AI can outperform Anthropic
simplifiedContent: Doximity is a company that works in the healthcare industry and uses artificial intelligence (AI) to help with medical tasks. The company's stock price went up by 60% after its CEO said that its AI is better than another company called Anthropic. This happened even though Doximity didn't do as well financially as expected, which is called an "earnings miss". Investors are excited about Doximity's AI capabilities and think it has a strong position in the healthcare industry. This is important because it shows that investors are focusing on the company's potential for the future, rather than just its current financial performance.

originalTitle: 9 IPOs get Sebi approval as primary market pipeline gathers pace
simplifiedContent: The stock market regulator, Sebi, has given the green light to nine companies to launch their Initial Public Offerings (IPOs). This means these companies, which work in various fields like engineering, travel, and renewable energy, can now raise money from the public by selling shares. The companies that got approval include Laxyo, Garuda Aerospace, and Jakson Green, among others. This is significant because it shows that many companies are getting ready to list their shares on the stock market, which can give investors more options to invest in. This development indicates that the market for new share sales is active and growing.

originalTitle: Airbnb shares surge 16% to 4-year high on Q2 beat; full-year outlook raised for second time
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening with Airbnb's stock: the company's shares went up 16% to $176.20, which is the highest they've been in 4 years. This happened because Airbnb had a great second quarter, making $3.6 billion in revenue and having more bookings. The company is doing well in important markets and people are still traveling a lot, even with some global concerns. As a result, Airbnb is feeling more optimistic about the rest of the year and has raised its expectations for the second time. This is good news for investors, as it suggests the company is doing well and expects to continue growing.

originalTitle: Pulse of the Street: Small-caps steal the show as equities extend gains
simplifiedContent: The stock market had a good week, with two important groups of stocks called "benchmarks" increasing in value by 0.51% and 0.76%. This means that the overall value of these stocks went up a little bit. The smaller companies, also known as "small-caps", did particularly well and got a lot of attention. This is important because it shows that the stock market is still growing, even if it's just a small amount. The increases in value are a sign that investors are feeling positive about the market.

originalTitle: Wall Street surges as weak jobs data eases Fed rate hike fears, chip stocks jump
simplifiedContent: The stock market is doing well today, with three major indexes (the S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq) all going up. The S&P 500 rose 0.4%, the Dow Jones rose 0.2%, and the Nasdaq rose 1% as of 9:55 a.m. This is happening because there was some news about jobs that was weaker than expected, which makes people think that the Federal Reserve might not raise interest rates as much. This is good for the stock market, which is why the indexes are rising. The Nasdaq, in particular, is doing well, which is also helping stocks related to computer chips to jump up.
